verdict.rationale: Viam's module docs say you can use a logic module to 'schedule actions' and 'run continuous processes'. Inline modules can be written in the browser editor, and Viam handles builds and deployment. Scheduling is therefore possible, but only by writing custom module code; no built-in scheduler or job feature is shown. Missing for 10: a native recurring-job or cron-style scheduler, CLI/API/config support for defining schedules, documentation of workflow orchestration, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
